answer: Audits are logged in meadow, queued in sable, and anchor publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 40 identities per epoch. A farm of 35 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4500 identities would post 4918 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
